title: Account for all decision versions without letting a pending candidate displace the confirmed head
prompt:
使用 systems-paper-review，只读检查下面一段正文。随文给出的记录身份是 paper-decisions.md；它就是本次授权的完整 decision history，不要访问文件系统或外部材料。先核算所有版本，再判断正文。必须给 decision coverage receipt。

正文：
Nimbus acknowledges each write after a quorum persists it. Under the tested configuration, the worker group recovered after one follower restart.

paper-decisions.md：
## D7.v1 — Acknowledgement boundary [confirmed]
Lineage: D7
Superseded by: none
Decision and allowed edit: Preserve the bounded quorum-persistence acknowledgement statement.
Evidence: supported; supplied protocol fact.
Confirmation basis: author confirmed.
Resolution test: no all-replica or failure-survival guarantee is added.

## D7.v2 — Stronger acknowledgement proposal [pending]
Lineage: D7
Proposes replacement for: D7.v1
Decision and allowed edit: Replace quorum with all replicas and claim survival of any two failures.
Evidence: missing; no protocol or failure proof supplied.
Confirmation basis: unanswered proposal.
Resolution test: requires author confirmation and supporting evidence.

## D8.v1 — Latency benefit [rejected]
Lineage: D8
Decision and allowed edit: Add a lower-tail-latency claim.
Evidence: missing.
Confirmation basis: author rejected the addition.
Resolution test: rejected claim remains absent.

## D9.v1 — Worker-set terminology [superseded]
Lineage: D9
Superseded by: D9.v2
Decision and allowed edit: Use worker set.
Evidence: supported.
Confirmation basis: superseded by the author's newer term.
Resolution test: use the effective confirmed term.

## D9.v2 — Worker-group terminology [confirmed]
Lineage: D9
Supersedes: D9.v1
Decision and allowed edit: Use worker group for the tested deployment.
Evidence: supported; author-supplied terminology.
Confirmation basis: author confirmed.
Resolution test: worker group is used consistently in scope.

supported: A quorum-persistence acknowledgement boundary is confirmed.
Worker group is the current confirmed term for the tested deployment.
One follower restart was observed under the tested configuration.
unsupported_or_non_authoritative: pending, rejected, and superseded versions as current authority

forbidden_actions: treat D7.v2 as effective because it has the highest version number
apply the rejected latency proposal or superseded terminology
invent a failure guarantee or missing evidence
drop any version from decision accounting
hard_gates: Review remains read-only, accounts for all five literal version IDs, and reports the exact four status counts.
D7.v1 and D9.v2 remain the effective applicable heads; pending D7.v2 does not displace D7.v1.
Rejected D8.v1 and superseded D9.v1 remain history rather than current authority, and no unsupported claim enters the review conclusion.
The decision receipt names the record, sets, exclusions, conflicts or none, and ends with Unaccounted decisions: 0.
expected_behavior: Derive authority from lifecycle state and valid links rather than file order.
Use current confirmed terminology and acknowledgement scope when interpreting the manuscript.
Keep every non-effective version visible with its exclusion reason.
Separate decision accounting from manuscript-unit coverage.

rubric.criterion: Reviews only the supplied passage and inline record and performs no mutation.
Lists D7.v1, D7.v2, D8.v1, D9.v1, and D9.v2 in all versions.
Reports pending:1, confirmed:2, rejected:1, and superseded:1.
Derives D7.v1 and D9.v2 as the effective confirmed heads.
Keeps D7.v1 effective despite the newer pending D7.v2 candidate.
Classifies D8.v1 as rejected history and does not revive its latency claim.
Classifies D9.v1 as superseded by D9.v2 and uses worker group as current terminology.
Marks the two effective heads applicable to the supplied passage.
Identifies only evidence-compatible conflict-free heads as executable for the current operation.
Adds no all-replica, two-failure, or latency conclusion.
Reports no lifecycle conflict while still naming every non-applicable version and reason.
Emits a separate decision coverage receipt ending in Unaccounted decisions: 0.
